description: Create clear, customizable Power BI risk matrix reports in minutes with Ultimate Risk Matrix. Ultimate Risk Matrix / Heatmap is a certified Power BI custom visual for identifying, assessing, prioritizing, and tracking risks by likelihood and impact. Build professional risk assessment matrices, risk heat maps, project risk dashboards, safety risk reports, audit views, IT risk dashboards, and enterprise risk management reports directly inside Microsoft Power BI. Turn complex risk data into a clear visual risk map. Plot risks on a classic likelihood-impact matrix, compare multiple risk values, and visualize the full lifecycle of each risk in a single chart — from initial risk to current risk, target risk, residual risk, or any other risk measure in your dataset. Designed for project management, engineering, health and safety, cybersecurity, compliance, audit, operations, and business reporting teams, Ultimate Risk Matrix helps you move beyond simple risk scoring and create interactive Power BI risk visuals that support faster, more confident decisions. Key Features • Full Custom Risk Matrix Builder Create fully customized risk matrices that match your organization’s methodology, including standard 4×4, 5×5, and 6×6 layouts as well as flexible dimensions such as 6×5 and other custom configurations. • Flexible Likelihood and Impact Axes Define custom axis ranges, labels, scoring…
